researchQuestion: Main question: Among women veterans using VA primary care in Texas, how do perceived barriers, perceived benefits, and cues to action relate to mental health service use?
hypotheses:
H1 (direct): Higher perceived barriers will predict higher mental health service use.

H2 (direct): Higher perceived benefits will be associated with higher mental health service use.

H3 (direct): Higher cues to action will be associated with higher mental health service use.
figureCaption:
Figure 1
Conceptual Model of Mental Health Service Use Among Women Veterans Using VA Primary Care in Texas, Based on Health Belief Model
Note. VA = U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.
